To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cultural orientations of Omani employees are different from each other and that they are linked to the preferences for particular HR policies and practices.

(a) Omani employees have a strong orientation toward mastery, harmony, being, and doing, and weak orientation toward hierarchy, collectivism and subjugation; (b) there is a clear relationship between cultural orientations and preferences for different HRM practices; (c) group-oriented HRM practices are positively related to being and collectivism, while they are negatively associated with hierarchy, subjugations and human nature as an evil;
“Omani employees prefer HRM practices that are group oriented, hierarchy oriented, and loose and informal. These preferences are influenced by the employees’ cultural orientations.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of cultural orientations on the preferences for HRM practices in the context of Oman.
the relationship between cultural orientations and HRM policies and practice preferences in Oman.
the relationship between value orientations and HRM preferences.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the findings of this study support the notion that cultural orientations influence the preference for HRM policies in Oman.
the Omani cultural orientations are more individualistic, and less group oriented, and less hierarchical.
the Omani culture is not a homogenous one.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cultural orientations influence preferences for HRM practices.
the findings of this study provide a clear link between the cultural orientations and employee preferences for HRM practices in the Omani context.
the cultural values of the country have an effect on the way people think, feel and behave in the workplace, which in turn has an influence on the way they would like to be treated at work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
cultural orientations are an important factor that should be considered by managers when designing HRM policies and implementing HRM practices.
HRM practices should be tailored according to the cultural context in order to achieve the highest level of employee satisfaction and organizational effectiveness.
HRM practices need to be adapted to the cultural context.
